## Business Profile
- **Company Name:** AT SELECTION Wholesale Garments
- **Brand Aliases / Search Keywords:** atselection.in, at selection, at selectio.in, at selection.in, atselection, AT Selection Hyderabad
- **Specialty:** Manufacturer, Stockist & Pan-India B2B Distributor of Bombay Frocks, Western Wear Sets, Crop Top & Choli, Pattu & Ethnic Wear, and 2-Piece Garment Bundles.
- **Showroom Address:** Shop No. 7, 8 & 9, Ground & 1st Floor, City Plaza Complex, Dewan Devdi, Hyderabad, Telangana 500002, India
- **Geo Coordinates:** Latitude 17.3616, Longitude 78.4747
- **Primary Wholesale WhatsApp Contact:** +91 97015 15477 (Syed Ahmer)
- **Trade Inquiry Lines:** +91 80199 25500 / +91 80199 24400

## B2B Ordering & Wholesale Dispatch Terms
1. **Minimum Order Quantity (MOQ):** Sold in complete size ratio sets (bundles of 4 or 6 pcs per design).
2. **Same-Day Dispatch:** Orders confirmed before 4:00 PM IST dispatched same day via Dewan Devdi transport network.
3. **Live Showroom Video Shopping:** Retailers can inspect fabric textures, embroidery, and flares live on WhatsApp Video Call (+91 97015 15477).
4. **Payment Modes:** Direct Bank Transfer (NEFT/RTGS/IMPS), UPI (GPay/PhonePe/Paytm).
